mission.name: Garnet S114 Closure & Hardening
mission.tagline: Accept the narrow truth, then harden the parts that made rejection tempting.
mission.northStar: S114 accepted at its true scope (first-party CLI/Wasm trust-kernel baseline) with durable evidence, mechanically bounded claims, fail-closed CLI lanes, and a rolling review control. Never overclaim.

policies.notes: auto = squash-merge own PR when full CI green, with the recorded 'Autonomous merge — agent: Claude Code (Fable 5); gates: ...' trailer (CLAUDE.md integrity rule 3), per Jon's 2026-07-12 execute-end-to-end directive and the #466-#471 convention. EXCEPTIONS (Jon-merge-only per CLAUDE.md integrity rule 1): any PR touching .github/workflows/, dogfood-gate scripts, diff-caps thresholds, or the capability-manifest standard — open those, park in resume.blockers. Never push tags. PRs touching F_Project_Management/, C_Language_Specification/, garnet-interp-v0.3/, examples/, Cargo.lock, or CURRENT_STATE.md need the full dogfood PR-body heading set (pre-validate: python scripts/check_dogfood_pr_body.py).

risks.title: Ledger regeneration is machine-dependent until the promo snapshot lands
risks.note: This machine probes composition-ready (50.0%) vs committed public-site-embedded (95.0%). P0-T2's snapshot design removes the dependence; until then never regenerate-and-commit the ledger without checking line 84.

risks.title: No GitHub branch protection on main
risks.note: protected:false — green-before-merge is agent discipline. Full CI (~27 checks, ~6 min) must be verified green before every autonomous squash-merge.

risks.title: New proof bundles can fail the repo-wide CI integrity gate
risks.note: Any malformed MANIFEST.sha256 or EOL slip under proofs/ fails ci.yml's evidence-integrity job for every later PR. Seal against committed bytes; run the gate locally before push (CRLF incident precedent).

risks.title: P3-T1 breaks a documented embedder contract
risks.note: CHANGELOG.md:297-303 advertises the permissive embedder default. The flip is deliberate plan work (condition #5) and must be recorded in CHANGELOG, not slipped in.

risks.title: CI-wiring PRs depend on Jon
risks.note: New gates run locally + are opened as parked PRs; they are not CI-enforced until Jon merges the wiring (integrity rule 1).
